error.account_mismatch: This login can't see any of the hot water systems this integration was set up with. To use a different Emerald account, remove and re-add the integration.
error.account_in_use: Another Emerald Hot Water System entry already signs in with this email address.

reconfigure.title: Update your Emerald account
reconfigure.description: Update your Emerald app password, or your email address if you have changed it in the Emerald app. The login must be able to see the hot water systems this integration already has. To use a different Emerald account, remove and re-add the integration.

auth_failed.title: Emerald rejected the saved credentials
auth_failed.description:
Emerald refused the credentials saved for {account} ({error}).

This is often a temporary problem at Emerald's end. Home Assistant keeps retrying, and this message clears itself once sign-in succeeds again.

If you have changed your Emerald password or email address, open the Emerald Hot Water System integration, choose Reconfigure, and enter the new details.
